analysis:
Documentation-only PR: docs/reference/protocol-messages.md (units :10, :11 show unchanged surrounding text at lines 948-1573; the add-on hold section at lines 171-195 is outside the supplied excerpts and was seen only as a truncated patch) and docs/threat-model.yaml (patch :1; :0 is metadata only). No runtime code changed, so no concrete regression is identified.

Threat model additions: A-018 (provider_serving_availability), TB-012 (local add-on hold AF_UNIX socket), T-059 (DoS by local holder). These describe the 0600 socket in a 0700 directory, a per-request LOCAL_PEERTOKEN audit-token check requiring same effective UID, Developer ID requirement, team SLDQ2GJ6TL and hardened runtime, lease bounds of 30-600s, a machine-lock fallback, persisted holds, and a hold that never sends provider_drain and never stops the App Attest worker. Limitations are honestly stated: same-UID tampering, add-on entitlements not inspected beyond the hardened runtime, and wall-clock leases.

Cross-check against existing definitions: busy fields on register and heartbeat (busy_reason, busy_since_ms, busy_addon) are optional and coordinator handling is declared separate platform work. This leaves an availability and routing-view contract not verifiable here. If the coordinator ignores draining plus busy fields, requests could route to a held provider. The doc says the coordinator excludes it, but that is an unverified external contract. The hold's interaction with TB-011 and T-053 (it does not drain the connection or revoke the authorization grant) is documented as intended, and no authorization change is evidenced.

Remaining questions for deeper review: the actual Swift implementation under provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Addon/ (AddonPeerPolicy, AddonIPCServer, ProviderLoop+AddonHold) is not supplied, so the documented mitigations are unverified. The patch excerpts are truncated. Whether the busy_addon string, which is operator-controlled, is sanitized or bounded on the coordinator is not shown; that is a privacy and size question, not evidenced as a defect.
